<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD is a well-formed, standard packaging file for the aifreeyoutube application. It fetches its source from the project's own official GitHub repository at a pinned, immutable tag (v1.0.1) with a valid SHA-256 checksum — there is no fetching of untrusted content at build time and no mutable-ref operations like `git pull`.

The build process is entirely conventional: `npm install` and `npm run build` in the frontend directory, followed by standard `go build` invocations for a desktop application (built with webkit2gtk) and a standalone server binary, with Go build flags (`-trimpath -buildmode=pie -modcacherw`, `-ldflags "-s -w"`) that are consistent with secure, reproducible Go packaging. No `eval`, `base64`, `curl`, or `wget` is used anywhere outside of AUR's standard source-fetching mechanism.

Installation steps are all routine: binaries to `/usr/bin`, a desktop launcher to `/usr/share/applications`, icons to the hicolor theme directories, and systemd unit files to the standard system/user service paths. These systemd units are packaging artifacts provided by upstream as part of the application's normal install, not system tampering. The `provides`/`conflicts` entry both set to `aifreeyoutube` is an odd packaging quirk but not malicious. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, backdoors, or injection of unrelated executable code.
</details>
